opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, have a meaningful connection to Scotland, are enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution for academic year 2026/27, and are not fully covered by public funding.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,820 per year towards Home‑rate undergraduate tuition fees for eligible low‑income Scottish students.
